name: Bone Fields
description: The Strong Fist clan traditionally cultivates food where they bury their fallen warriors, adorning the site with the bones of giant beasts. They believe the food will absorb the essence of the fallen warriors and strengthen people. At the end of each day, shamans perform a blessing ritual, asking for the spirits to help the plants grow. However, the scent of their dead warrior attracts undead creatures at night, occasionally resulting in attacks against the shamans. As tradition demands, orcs are forbidden from battling within these sacred grounds, so the shamans are in search of external help to solve the problem.
